{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out those with missing age (age == -1)
valid_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding missing age): {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
